application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
This is notice to let you know that on 19 May 2026 the Council made the above Tree Preservation Order No. TP26/0005.

A copy of the Order has been posted to the property and shall be emailed to the agent. 
In summary it prohibits anyone from cutting down, topping or lopping any of the trees described in the First Schedule and shown on the map, without the Council's Consent.

The Council has made the Order on the following grounds:

Application ref. PA26/1022 was received by the Council on 24/03/2026 and sought consent for the removal of three yew trees located to the front of the property, bordering Richmond Park. The application cited disease, decay, and damage to a nearby listed wall as justification for the proposed removals. However, no arboricultural assessment, structural evidence, or other supporting information was submitted to substantiate these claims. In the absence of evidence demonstrating that the trees are diseased, structurally unsound, or responsible for the alleged damage, the reasons provided are considered insufficient to justify their removal.
